description: Times dependent shared-memory read/update/write traffic over a 48 KiB array with unique per-thread ownership. Patterns use consecutive words or stride-32 words within logical 32-lane groups; effective bank behavior depends on the target. Emits raw times and layout descriptors.

scaling_param.name: inner_iters
scaling_param.description: Number of inner-loop iterations per kernel launch; controls total shared memory traffic

non_scaling_params.name: block_size
non_scaling_params.description: Threads per block; a positive multiple of 32 within the device limit

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of blocks; the declared sweep uses one block. Multiplication by SM/CU count is an extrapolation, not a measured device-wide rate.

non_scaling_params.name: access_pattern
non_scaling_params.description: Logical 32-lane address layout: consecutive four-byte words or distinct words with stride 32; qualify effective bank behavior on the target

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: When true, run the untimed vector-add warmer to raise clocks and disturb cache state; qualify its effect on the target. False disables it without promising a particular cache state.
